title: Annealed Kernel Mixer: online seq-len & arch-aware kernel tuning
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Current kernel selection is brittle across heterogeneous fleets and variable sequence-length distributions. We observe cases where the selector locks onto a high-throughput kernel for long prefill stages, then suffers huge decode latency regressions when short-beam decoding dominates. Goal: implement an online, multi-objective kernel mixer that (1) blends kernel policies per-architecture cluster, (2) probes cheap microbenchmarks during prefill slack, and (3) anneals toward low-latency kernels during decode windows. The system must be safe for production (no noisy mass rollouts), explainable, and provide measurable unit-economics improvements.
acceptance_criteria: 1) End-to-end A/B benchmark shows >=5% cost-per-token reduction on average for heterogeneous workloads without increasing 99th percentile decode latency by >5%.
2) New mixer publishes per-request rationale (kernel blend weights + score) in tracing for Console observability.
3) Can rollback to current selector at route level with zero request loss and no manual migration of KV caches.
4) Autoscaling and canary rollout integration completed in runtime-1.23 release.
5) Smoke tests across A100-80GB, A30, and T4 hardware with seq_len buckets [<64, 64-256, 256-1024] pass latency/throughput gates.
comments: 2025-02-12 Asha Patel: Created RFC and initial spike plan. Motivation: customers with mixed bursty workloads saw 10-18% cost overshoot due to poor kernel switching. Proposed approach: simulated-annealing style mixer + microprobe during prefill low-priority windows.

2025-02-18 Miguel Torres: Completed microprobe harness (ENG-100432). Microprobe runs 50-200ms synthetic prefill samples and captures per-kernel throughput/latency/cold-kv penalty. Early numbers: on A100-80GB, kernel Kx yields 8% higher throughput for seq_len 1024 but 14ms higher median decode latency at seq_len 32 vs kernel Ky.
2025-02-21 Design review (Lena Schwartz): Mixer UI should surface blend weights and recent probe history. Added label 'pm-visibility' to surface this to Console team.

2025-02-25 Performance spike: ran end-to-end 48h sim with 20% tail-heavy traffic. Mixer reduced average tokens/sec cost by 6.4% vs baseline selector, but 99th decode latency regressed by 6.8% in one config. Investigated: anneal schedule too slow to prioritize decode windows.

2025-02-27 Engineering decision: switch to asymmetric annealing: aggressive cool-down at decode-start events (when request route indicates decode phase). Implemented a decode-triggered temperature drop and prefill slack probing throttle. See PR #3542.

2025-03-03 QA: Canary on runtime-qa cluster (10% traffic for backend cohort). Observed: median decode latency improved 9ms for short sequences; throughput for prefill-dominated workloads remained within 2% of baseline. No KV-cache corruption. Added integration test to validate KV cache migration path between kernel instances.
2025-03-05 PM note (Ravi Menon): Prepare customer-facing notes and console changelog for runtime-1.23. Highlight that customers can set policy hints (opt_for: latency|cost|balanced) at route level.

2025-03-06 Miguel Torres: Updated selector to emit blended rationale in trace and enabled canary config for selected production routes. Next: expand hardware matrix and run 72h soak on mixed enterprise traces.
